items.title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/F…
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password, not access to the patient, encounter, or form type. Authenticated core users can supply arbitrary formId, formDir, and encounterId values to sign and lock any patient's clinical form, creating unauthorized approval records and blocking normal editing.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.1 and 16.0.0 before 16.19.0 lacks a write permission check on a bulk record processing…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.1 and 16.0.0 before 16.19.0 lacks a write permission check on a bulk record processing action, allowing users with only read access to the related setup record to modify data. Authenticated users with the default Employee role can run the action to create and submit records for every covered employee.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.2 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain r…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.2 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain record update endpoints that lack an ownership check. Authenticated users with the Employee role can call these endpoints to modify records belonging to other employees, beyond their permitted role.

items.title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Patient Validation module that allows any au…
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Patient Validation module that allows any authenticated user to retrieve patient demographic records. Attackers can send direct requests with wildcard mf_lname or empty mf_ parameters to the patientvalidation endpoint to enumerate the entire patient_data table.

items.title: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-…
items.description: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket host implementation that lets guests bypass socket_addr_check send restrictions. A malicious guest can race udp-socket.send against udp-socket.connect to deliver attacker-controlled datagrams to addresses the policy permits only for receiving.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.50.0 lacks authorization checks on certain HR workflow endpoints, letting authenticated us…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.50.0 lacks authorization checks on certain HR workflow endpoints, letting authenticated users access records they are not permitted to view. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can read candidate record details and employee email addresses, and cause emails to be sent to employees.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 15.x before 15.64.1 and 16.x before 16.19.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint t…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 15.x before 15.64.1 and 16.x before 16.19.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint that returns file information, allowing authenticated users to read details of files attached to records they cannot access. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can query it to view attachment details on any document type and confirm record existence.

items.title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vu…
items.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype does not validate that the supplied supertype belongs to the same Engine. Embedders using multiple engines that create a GC struct type with another engine's supertype can trigger runtime panics or GC heap corruption, causing denial of service; guest WebAssembly cannot trigger it.

items.title: Coder 2.28.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38…
items.description: Coder 2.28.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 does not restrict new API keys to the creating token's scopes, allow list, or expiry. A scoped API key or OAuth2 token holding key-creation permission can call POST /api/v2/users/{user}/keys/tokens to mint longer-lived coder:all keys, gaining the user's full privileges.

items.title: Coder 2.21.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38…
items.description: Coder 2.21.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 reads Web Push endpoint responses in webpushSend with io.ReadAll, without a size limit or client timeout. Any authenticated user can register a subscription via POST /api/v2/users/{user}/webpush/subscription pointing to a server returning an endless body, exhausting coderd memory and crashing the API, dashboard, and workspace connections.

items.title: The wasmtime-wasi-http p2 implementation in Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50…
items.description: The wasmtime-wasi-http p2 implementation in Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 can send conflicting content-length headers, or ones not matching the body, in outgoing requests. A guest that reuses a received response's headers resource to send a bodyless request can enable request smuggling against non-compliant servers, potentially bypassing embedder destination access controls.

items.title: Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 allocates untracked host…
items.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 allocates untracked host memory when a component receives a borrow of a resource it defines itself, bypassing the per-store handle limit. A malicious guest component can repeatedly transfer such borrowed resources to consume arbitrary host memory, causing denial of service.

items.title: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in th…
items.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in the TypedFunc embedder API for I31, Option<I31>, and Option<NoneRef> parameter or result types, reaching an unreachable!() path. A malicious guest module exporting a function that uses another anyref-hierarchy type can panic the host embedding, causing denial of service.

items.title: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server…
items.description: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory through quadratic XML canonicalization of unsigned SAML responses. Attackers can send a single crafted SAML response with deeply nested elements declaring new namespace prefixes to POST /api/v1/fleet/sso/callback, crashing the Fleet server.

items.title: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in its user administration API that accepts user creation…
items.description: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in its user administration API that accepts user creation or modification when the caller administers any one of the assigned teams. Authenticated team administrators can grant users administrator roles on other teams, then deploy software and execute scripts on those teams' hosts.

items.title: Coder 2.26.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38…
items.description: Coder 2.26.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 contains an improper authorization flaw in the external agent credentials endpoint, which returns the workspace agent token to users with only workspace read access rather than ssh permission. Authenticated users with roles such as Template Admin or Organization Admin can use the token to read the owner's private Git SSH key and Git provider OAuth tokens, and impersonate the agent to receive the owner's sessions.

items.title: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.30.0 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in GPUModelRunner._init_xdrope_positions th…
items.description: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.30.0 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in GPUModelRunner._init_xdrope_positions that allows remote attackers to crash the engine by submitting embeddings-only requests. Attackers can send a /v1/completions request containing only prompt_embeds to XD-RoPE models with --enable-prompt-embeds, terminating the EngineCore and API server for all clients.

items.title: vLLM from 0.19.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows inference clients to bypass the…
items.description: vLLM from 0.19.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows inference clients to bypass the server frame limit by setting media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames in chat completion requests. Attackers can supply num_frames=-1 or a large value with many base64 JPEG frames, forcing VideoMediaIO to decode all frames and np.stack them, causing memory exhaustion.

items.title: Password Pusher from 1.49.0 before 2.17.0 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability that allows remote clients to forge the…
items.description: Password Pusher from 1.49.0 before 2.17.0 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability that allows remote clients to forge the recorded request IP via unanchored trusted-proxy regular expressions. Clients in 110.0.0.0/8 or 210.0.0.0/8, or connecting directly, can supply X-Forwarded-For values to falsify audit log entries and shift password generator rate limits.

items.title: vLLM from 0.10.1 before 0.31.0 forwards a request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs.max_patches value to the Hugging Face…
items.description: vLLM from 0.10.1 before 0.31.0 forwards a request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs.max_patches value to the Hugging Face processor for Cohere2 Vision models without a server-side upper bound, causing quadratic CPU work during multimodal preprocessing. Remote clients can send small image chat-completion requests with large, varying max_patches values to bypass the LRU cache, exhaust preprocessing workers, and deny service to other clients.

items.title: vLLM 0.30.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in OpenCVDynamicOpenPanguVideoBackend, which use…
items.description: vLLM 0.30.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in OpenCVDynamicOpenPanguVideoBackend, which uses request-controlled num_frames without an effective ceiling. Unauthenticated attackers can send /v1/chat/completions or /tokenize requests selecting the openpangu video_backend with a huge num_frames, forcing np.linspace allocations and CPU work that OOM-kill the API server.

items.title: vLLM from 0.14.0rc1 before 0.31.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in sanitize_message() whose lowercas…
items.description: vLLM from 0.14.0rc1 before 0.31.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in sanitize_message() whose lowercase-only regex fails to scrub uppercase PIL image addresses. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted PNG to endpoints such as /tokenize, triggering HF-processor errors that leak live server heap addresses useful for ASLR bypass.

items.title: vLLM from 0.24.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MiniMax M3 VL video processor, which…
items.description: vLLM from 0.24.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MiniMax M3 VL video processor, which accepts request-level min_pixels without range or min_pixels <= max_pixels validation. Its video-wide pixel budget is enforced only when max_long_side_pixel is set, and that value defaults to None. API clients can supply a large min_pixels via mm_processor_kwargs to enlarge every decoded frame, causing excessive CPU and host-memory consumption that may disrupt workers or the service.

items.title: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the skill-install download path because fe…
items.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the skill-install download path because fetchBytes performs only a parse-time hostname check instead of using ssrfSafeClient. Attackers can supply a skill URL via the MCP skill install action that redirects or DNS-rebinds to loopback addresses, reaching internal services and metadata endpoints.

items.title: Parse Server from 9.10.6-alpha.1 before 9.10.8-alpha.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows cli…
items.description: Parse Server from 9.10.6-alpha.1 before 9.10.8-alpha.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with write but not read access to learn whether fields are stored on MongoDB. Attackers can send updates with dot notation operations on top-level fields and observe internal server errors versus success responses to infer field existence.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an insufficient isolation vulnerability in workflow expression evaluation that allows auth…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an insufficient isolation vulnerability in workflow expression evaluation that allows authenticated users to escape the sandbox. Attackers with permission to create or modify workflows can craft expressions referencing unexpected JavaScript properties to execute arbitrary code on the n8n host.

items.title: n8n before 2.46.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that forwards Authorization headers and basic auth crede…
items.description: n8n before 2.46.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that forwards Authorization headers and basic auth credentials on cross-origin redirects because sendCredentialsOnCrossOriginRedirect defaults to true. Attackers controlling a redirect target or an expression-fed URL in credential-using nodes can capture stored workflow credentials sent to their endpoint.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Chat Trigger that allows unauthenticated att…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Chat Trigger that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip n8n User Auth through the setup GET webhook route in embedded chat mode. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to the chat webhook URL to read named session conversation history or trigger workflows with attacker-supplied input.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89 contains a credential leakage vulnerability in the NocoDB node that sends the configured NocoDB API…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89 contains a credential leakage vulnerability in the NocoDB node that sends the configured NocoDB API token to attacker-chosen hosts when downloading attachments. Attackers with write access to a NocoDB attachment cell can insert a URL to their host, capturing the API token when the workflow executes with Download Attachments enabled.

items.title: n8n before 2.46.1 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read server files…
items.description: n8n before 2.46.1 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read server files by supplying absolute paths to the Browser Use browser_upload tool. Attackers with a connected remote browser session can have Playwright read files such as instance configuration from the n8n server and retrieve their contents from the page.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 bundles a GraphicsMagick version wit…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 bundles a GraphicsMagick version with known vulnerabilities in its official Docker image, which the Edit Image node uses to process images. Attackers who can supply crafted untrusted images to an Edit Image workflow, such as one fed by a Webhook node, can execute code on the n8n instance.

items.title: n8n before 2.38.0 and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Asana Trigger that accept…
items.description: n8n before 2.38.0 and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Asana Trigger that accepts a new webhook verification secret from any request carrying an X-Hook-Secret header. Unauthenticated attackers who know the webhook URL can replace the secret, send forged Asana events that pass signature verification, and trigger workflows with attacker-controlled data while genuine deliveries are rejected.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a NoSQL injection vulnerabi…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a NoSQL injection vulnerability in the MongoDB node's Update and Find And Replace operations due to insufficient validation of the update key value taken from incoming items. Attackers who can supply untrusted input, such as a webhook body, to a workflow using these operations can make the node match and overwrite unintended documents or insert new documents in the MongoDB database.

items.title: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an open redirect vulnerabil…
items.description: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated MCP OAuth dynamic client registration flow, which accepts arbitrary redirect_uri values via the /mcp-oauth/register endpoint. Attackers can send victims crafted /mcp-oauth/authorize URLs that redirect them to attacker-controlled sites before instance checks run, enabling phishing.

items.title: n8n before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a flaw in the OAuth2 credential callback of the…
items.description: n8n before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a flaw in the OAuth2 credential callback of the dynamic-credential connect flow, which does not verify that the completing browser belongs to the user who started the flow. Members with access to a resolvable OAuth2 credential can send the provider authorization URL to a victim; if the victim consents without an active n8n session, the victim's tokens are stored under the member's identity, letting the member's workflows act as the victim.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. Attackers with admin credentials can upload a ZIP containing a PHP file whose path includes /theme.php to achieve remote code execution on nginx deployments.

items.title: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass in system/traits/media.php where '.phar' is misconfigured with a leadin…
items.description: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass in system/traits/media.php where '.phar' is misconfigured with a leading dot, allowing authenticated administrators to upload .phar PHP files. Attackers can upload a GIF magic-byte polyglot webshell bypassing binary inspection and execute arbitrary OS commands as the web-server user.

items.title: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that u…
items.description: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that uses loose comparison to validate MD5 cookie hashes. Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force cookie values until the server's MD5 computation yields a 0e magic hash, then forge persistent cookies for account takeover.

items.title: Vvveb 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete server-side request forgery fix that allows authenticated admin users to bypass DN…
items.description: Vvveb 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete server-side request forgery fix that allows authenticated admin users to bypass DNS pinning by requesting non-443 URLs. Attackers can supply a rebinding hostname to the editor oEmbedProxy url parameter to read loopback services, internal panels, and cloud metadata credentials.

items.title: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete authorization fix that allows low-privilege authors and vendors to…
items.description: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete authorization fix that allows low-privilege authors and vendors to access other users' records by bypassing admin_id owner scoping. Attackers can supply filter[admin_id] to list drafts, invoke duplicate() on posts or products, or enumerate every vendor's digital-asset metadata.

items.title: n8n before 2.43.5, 2.44.x before 2.44.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Vector Sto…
items.description: n8n before 2.43.5, 2.44.x before 2.44.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Vector Store (OracleDB) node, which does not validate Metadata Filter keys used in vector search queries. Attackers can supply crafted filter keys through untrusted workflow input such as webhooks to read data accessible to the configured Oracle credential.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP by saving .sql files through the admin code editor. Attackers can bypass extension and content deny-lists with an @IF macro payload that compiles into executable PHP when the model loads, running OS commands as the web user.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-41934 that allows authenticated editor or site_admin user…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-41934 that allows authenticated editor or site_admin users to write server-side templates by bypassing save restrictions. Attackers can upload or rename .tpl files via editor/code upload and rename actions, or evade isExecutableFile checks in save(), to inject PHP code into templates.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege vendors to rename, delet…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege vendors to rename, delete, or overwrite other vendors' digital-asset files in the shared storage/digital_assets directory. Attackers can send rename, delete, or upload requests to product/digital-asset with another vendor's filename to break downloads or substitute malicious content.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in Admin_Auth_TokenSQL::update(), which interpolates admi…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in Admin_Auth_TokenSQL::update(), which interpolates admin_auth_token array keys into an INSERT column list without a column whitelist or backtick escaping. Authenticated admin-panel users can submit backtick-containing keys to the admin/auth-token save action to inject comments and column identifiers into the SQL statement.

items.title: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the content/revisions revision action t…
items.description: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the content/revisions revision action that lets low-privileged Authors read other authors' revisions. Attackers can supply a post_id, language_id, and created_at timestamp to retrieve private unpublished drafts, because the revision() action lacks the admin_id ownership restriction.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because the @KEYS(:each) macro emits PHP array keys as ba…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because the @KEYS(:each) macro emits PHP array keys as backtick-quoted INSERT column names without escaping, and several procedures in admin/sql/mysqli/product.sql and admin_auth_token.sql omit the @FILTER guard. Authenticated back-office users able to save products can submit product_<feature> POST array keys containing backticks to redirect bound values into unexposed columns or break SQL statements.

items.title: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an unsanitized deserialization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to contr…
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an unsanitized deserialization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to control patient-matching criteria by supplying a crafted serialized key parameter. Attackers can send serialized arrays to interface/orders/patient_match_dialog.php to enumerate patients or force matches that associate lab orders with the wrong patient.

items.title: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:edit to bypa…
items.description: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:edit to bypass the file-browser path guard by combining symlinks with '..' sequences. Attackers can read /proc/self/environ, the SQLite database, and the encryption key via /api/system/files/content, or move them using the stack relocate endpoint, exposing stored credentials.

items.title: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:create…
items.description: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:create permission to read sensitive files by supplying an arbitrary composePath during stack adoption. Attackers can adopt a stack pointing to the encryption key, SQLite database, or /proc/self/environ and read it via the compose endpoint to obtain all stored credentials.

items.title: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that lets users holding only containers:view do…
items.description: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that lets users holding only containers:view download arbitrary container files instead of requiring containers:exec. Authenticated Enterprise RBAC users can request any path from the files/download endpoint, which reads through Docker's archive API, to retrieve secrets, keys, and mounted credentials.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform admin state-…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform admin state-changing actions because checkCsrf() in admin/controller/base.php only validates tokens for POST requests. Attackers can lure a logged-in admin into loading a forged cross-site GET request to delete admin/user accounts, sites, orders, and menus or change comment status.

items.title: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege author or vendor u…
items.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege author or vendor users to inject script by bypassing the regex blacklist in sanitizeHTML(). Attackers can save post or product content with unclosed event-handler tags or javascript: entities to execute script for anonymous visitors and admins, enabling session or CSRF-token theft.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's te…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's telemetry setting, and some events include more detail than needed. During normal use, with no user action, values such as leave type names, claimed amounts and appraisal scores are transmitted even when telemetry is disabled.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.6 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 does not check access to each employee on endpoints that cr…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.6 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 does not check access to each employee on endpoints that create records in bulk for a list of employees. An authenticated user with create permission on the affected record type, such as HR User, can create records for employees outside their user-permission scope, including other companies' employees.

items.title: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users t…
items.description: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read company details outside their permissions due to a missing permission check. Any logged-in user, including Employee role users, can query the affected endpoint to list every company on the site along with its default currency.

items.title: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an authorization bypass because an ownership check is missing on a record ty…
items.description: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an authorization bypass because an ownership check is missing on a record type that employees can create. Authenticated users holding only the Employee role can create or change draft records for another employee, or for a company they do not belong to.

items.title: REDAXO before 5.21.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows editors without the version[live_versio…
items.description: REDAXO before 5.21.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows editors without the version[live_version] permission to modify live article versions by bypassing working version enforcement. Authenticated editors can add, edit, delete, toggle, or reorder live slices via content/functions, slice ids, content_slice_status, content_move_slice, history restore, or content_copy, bypassing approval workflows.

items.title: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that places the subscription key…
items.description: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that places the subscription key in the query string of outbound subscription status requests. Attackers with access to proxy, server, or monitoring logs along the request path can recover the site's subscription key from recorded URLs.

items.title: Nezha Dashboard before 2.6.0 contains multiple authorization, tenant isolation, and resource exhaustion vulnerabilities…
items.description: Nezha Dashboard before 2.6.0 contains multiple authorization, tenant isolation, and resource exhaustion vulnerabilities that allow members or unauthenticated attackers to abuse NAT, DDNS, OAuth, cron, and server transfer features. Attackers can claim undeclared Dashboard hostnames to capture login bodies, hijack DDNS profiles, create executable schedules without exec scope, or exhaust memory via buffered NAT requests.

items.title: The web dashboard in Coder 2.24.0 before 2.29.23, 2.30.0 before 2.34.14, 2.35.0 before 2.36.9, 2.37.0 before 2.37.6, an…
items.description: The web dashboard in Coder 2.24.0 before 2.29.23, 2.30.0 before 2.34.14, 2.35.0 before 2.36.9, 2.37.0 before 2.37.6, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.2 replaces the $SESSION_TOKEN placeholder in external app URLs with a full-access API key without checking whether the app belongs to a sub-agent. Code running in a workspace can register a disguised sub-agent app with a custom protocol URL, so the owner's click sends their API key to an attacker-chosen destination.

items.title: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Transit key import that allows authenticated…
items.description: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Transit key import that allows authenticated attackers to bypass name restrictions in ACL policies. Attackers limited by a required_parameters name constraint can craft traversal sequences during import to write key material under arbitrary Transit key names.

items.title: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2, and the openbao-plugins LDAP and RADIUS auth plugins before 0.2.0, contain…
items.description: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2, and the openbao-plugins LDAP and RADIUS auth plugins before 0.2.0, contain an ACL bypass in the AppRole, Cert, LDAP, and RADIUS auth methods caused by implicit path canonicalization. Authenticated attackers can request non-canonical paths for AppRole Role IDs, Cert CRLs, LDAP groups and users, or RADIUS users to evade ACL deny rules.

items.title: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated callers to o…
items.description: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated callers to obtain OIDC ID tokens by abusing public clients with client_credentials enabled. Attackers who know a public client's client_id can request tokens from the identity/oidc/provider/<name>/token endpoint to impersonate the client without any secret.

items.title: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2 does not neutralize wildcard characters in SSH certificate principals rende…
items.description: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2 does not neutralize wildcard characters in SSH certificate principals rendered from unvalidated external token metadata via identity templates in the SSH secrets engine. Attackers controlling that metadata, typically through a compromised identity provider, can inject '*' to obtain SSH certificates valid for multiple hosts or users.

items.title: NLTK: Unbounded CPU consumption in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() with ambiguous or self-embedding grammars
items.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() that lacks any max_time deadline or step limit. Attackers influencing the grammar can supply an ambiguous self-embedding grammar and short token input to force unbounded top-down search, pinning CPU cores and exhausting worker pools.

items.title: NLTK: Symlink escape in YCOECorpusReader lets a psd/pos directory symlink read files outside the corpus root within the data sandbox
items.description: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink escape vulnerability in YCOECorpusReader that allows attackers to read files outside the corpus root by planting psd or pos directory symlinks. Attackers controlling a YCOE corpus can make parsed_sents() and tagged_words() return file content from other corpora or temporary files within the NLTK data sandbox.

items.title: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privi…
items.description: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to upload crafted SVG images that submit authenticated POST requests to arbitrary backend endpoints. Attackers can trick an administrator into opening the SVG in a separate browser tab and clicking it, performing administrator actions such as elevating the attacker's account to administrator.

items.title: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Knowledge Base art…
items.description: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Knowledge Base articles that lets users with Knowledge Base create or edit access attach a JavaScript file and add a crafted link to the article body. When an administrator clicks the link, the script runs in their session and can create an administrator account with attacker-chosen credentials.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic CPU exhaustion in LegalitySyllableTokenizer.tokenize via unguarded onset reversal loop
items.description: NLTK from 3.6 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in LegalitySyllableTokenizer.tokenize that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying long all-vowel tokens. Attackers can submit a token such as a long run of vowels, causing the unguarded onset reversal loop to perform quadratic work and deny service to syllabification components.

items.title: NLTK: Symlink escape in chat80.sql_query bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox to read out-of-root SQLite databases
items.description: NLTK from 3.9.4 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink following vulnerability in nltk.sem.chat80.sql_query() that bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox containment check. Attackers who can write into a trusted NLTK data root can plant a symbolic link to read SQLite databases outside the sandbox.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in ConllCorpusReader SRL instance builder via nested span rescan
items.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in ConllCorpusReader._get_srl_instances that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through nested span rescans. Attackers can supply a crafted CoNLL SRL corpus with many predicates and span columns, placing the head span last, to pin a core for minutes.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in Tree.chomsky_normal_form right-factor binarization via list.pop(0)
items.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in Tree.chomsky_normal_form that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time right-factor binarization using list.pop(0). Attackers can supply a wide flat treebank tree parsed by Tree.fromstring to force tens of seconds of single-threaded CPU consumption, blocking the processing thread.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in CCG lexicon parser (fromstring) on wide bracket bodies and operator chains
items.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the CCG lexicon parser fromstring that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying wide inputs. Attackers can submit lexicon text with long flat bracket bodies or operator chains, triggering quadratic string re-slicing in matchBrackets and augParseCategory that blocks worker threads.

items.title: NLTK: BllipParser passes caller-supplied model paths to the bllipparser C extension with no pathsec check, enabling arbitrary read
items.description: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in BllipParser that allows attackers to open files outside NLTK data roots by supplying unvalidated model paths. Attackers controlling parser_model, reranker_features, reranker_weights, or from_unified_model_dir() input can make the bllipparser C extension read sensitive files or block on FIFOs and devices.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic CPU exhaustion in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize via list.pop(0) in quote-restore loop
items.description: NLTK from 3.2.5 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize that allows remote attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption through repeated list.pop(0) calls. Attackers can submit long runs of double-quote characters to services span-tokenizing untrusted text, exhausting a CPU core and degrading availability.

items.title: NLTK: Path Traversal in save_maxent_params / load_maxent_params Allow Arbitrary File READ/WRITE
items.description: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in save_maxent_params() and load_maxent_params() that bypasses the pathsec filesystem restriction mechanism. Attackers who control the tab_dir argument can read or overwrite model parameter files outside permitted data roots, because the functions call Python's built-in open() directly.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in base-user.cte.utils.ts, which concatenates base memb…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in base-user.cte.utils.ts, which concatenates base members' email addresses into the SQL text of queries resolving user, created-by or last-modified-by fields. Registered users can set an email with a quoted local part containing a single quote to execute arbitrary SQL, exposing user records, API tokens and data-source credentials.

items.title: Grav Login plugin before 3.11.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with an account p…
items.description: Grav Login plugin before 3.11.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with an account password to skip two-factor verification when the global twofa_enabled setting is off. Attackers can sign in through the /login form, remember-me cookie, or magic link to obtain a session the API plugin accepts, gaining full account permissions including super-admin control.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in base-integrations.service.ts that allows au…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in base-integrations.service.ts that allows authenticated base members to read private integration configurations by omitting a query flag. Attackers can request another user's private integration without the configuration flag, bypassing the ownership check to obtain stored connection credentials.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an attachment size limit bypass that allows authenticated Editor users to store oversi…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an attachment size limit bypass that allows authenticated Editor users to store oversized files because data-attachment-v3.service.ts trusts the remote server's advertised content length. Attackers can point the v3 upload-by-URL endpoint at a server that understates or omits its length to exhaust disk space or storage quota.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the profile update handler in users.service…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the profile update handler in users.service.ts, which returns the stored user record without passing it through the user-serialization filter, exposing the bcrypt password hash, salt, and session token counter. Attackers holding a stolen or hijacked session can update the profile to retrieve that account's password hash and salt for offline cracking.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in PageLeavingWarning.vue that allows u…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in PageLeavingWarning.vue that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute script by embedding an ASCII control character in the ncRedirectUrl scheme. Attackers can send a crafted link that bypasses the scheme check and reaches the anchor href or window.location, stealing the session token from localStorage for account takeover.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with read access to run…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with read access to run arbitrary read queries via the legacy where parameter on PostgreSQL. Attackers, including Viewer-role users, can inject single quotes into filter values concatenated by CustomKnex.ts to read other tables, schemas, view-filtered rows, and hidden columns.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retri…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve full OAuth client records by querying the public client lookup route in oauth.controller.ts. Attackers who know or guess a client identifier can obtain the registration access token to modify or delete registrations, plus the bcrypt client secret hash and owner's internal identifier.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains a race condition vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that allows attackers to reus…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains a race condition vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that allows attackers to reuse a refresh token by presenting it concurrently during non-atomic rotation. Attackers holding a captured refresh token can race the legitimate client to obtain their own access and refresh tokens, retaining scoped access without triggering reuse detection.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in export.service.ts that writes record values a…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in export.service.ts that writes record values and column titles beginning with formula characters into CSV exports without neutralization. Low-privileged collaborators, or unauthenticated users submitting a public form, can plant formulas that execute when a user opens the export in a spreadsheet application, potentially exfiltrating cell contents or invoking external commands.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a race condition in refresh-token rotation that allows attackers to reuse tokens becau…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a race condition in refresh-token rotation that allows attackers to reuse tokens because UserRefreshToken.ts never checks the affected-row count. Attackers holding a captured refresh token can present it concurrently with the legitimate user to obtain a valid authenticated session, and no reuse event is recorded.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains a race condition vulnerability in users.service.ts that allows holders of a valid rese…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains a race condition vulnerability in users.service.ts that allows holders of a valid reset token to perform multiple password changes by sending concurrent reset requests. Attackers can exploit the window created by slow bcrypt hashing before the token is cleared to overwrite the owner's new password and lock them out.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets base-scoped API tokens act as accou…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets base-scoped API tokens act as account-wide credentials because the token's base_id is never stored or checked. Attackers holding a leaked token can read, write and delete records on every base the token owner belongs to, including bases joined later.

items.title: NocoDB from 2026.04.0 before 2026.08.0 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in org-users.service.ts…
items.description: NocoDB from 2026.04.0 before 2026.08.0 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in org-users.service.ts where updating a user's legacy organization role rewrites their default-workspace role. Revoked users can silently regain Creator-level read, write and schema modification access across all default-workspace bases using their existing session token.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the copy-from branch of integration creation…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the copy-from branch of integration creation in integrations.service.ts that decrypts a source integration's connection credentials without checking its owner or private flag. Authenticated users with the Creator role can supply guessed or enumerated integration ids to copy other users' private database host, username, and password into an integration they own.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in PromptWithFields.vue that renders unesc…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in PromptWithFields.vue that renders unescaped field references from AI field prompts as HTML in a tooltip. Attackers with the Creator role or above can store markup in a prompt's field reference that executes when victims open the field configuration, stealing the localStorage session token to call authenticated APIs as the victim.

items.title: NocoDB from 2026.05.2 before 2026.07.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Editor-role use…
items.description: NocoDB from 2026.05.2 before 2026.07.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Editor-role users to fetch internal URLs because data import reused the webhook internal-network exemption. When NC_ALLOW_LOCAL_HOOKS or NC_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK is set, attackers can request internal services via URLs ending in CSV or spreadsheet extensions and read the responses.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator users to…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator users to inject script by embedding markup in column or table titles. The Delete.vue confirmation dialog renders these titles through an unescaped innerHTML binding, executing script when a victim deletes an external-source table to steal session tokens from localStorage.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in initAdminFromEnv.ts that silently skips super-…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in initAdminFromEnv.ts that silently skips super-admin bootstrap when the admin password environment variable is empty. Unauthenticated attackers can call the public signup endpoint first on a fresh instance to receive Creator and Super Admin roles, gaining full administrative control.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attacke…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources by sending unbounded filter arrays to shared-view bulk endpoints. Attackers with a shared view UUID can POST a large body of minimal filter objects, triggering a full database query per entry, to crash the NocoDB process.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that treats PKCE as a…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that treats PKCE as a substitute for confidential client authentication, skipping client secret verification when omitted. Attackers holding a captured authorization code and PKCE verifier can mint access tokens and 60-day refresh tokens for a confidential client without knowing its secret.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass bulk row-count limits by using session authentication instead of API tokens. Attackers with Editor write permission on one table can submit hundreds of thousands of rows to v1 and v2 bulk write routes, exhausting database connections, CPU, and memory.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to r…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-base row comments by supplying only model and row ids. Attackers with a Viewer or Creator role on an unrelated base can read private comments and author emails, or plant decoy tables and duplicate comment ids to spoof teammates' comments.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to execute scripts by storing crafted attachment MIME types like text/html;image/png. Attackers can write the value through the records API so the /dltemp signed URL serves HTML inline, stealing session tokens from localStorage to impersonate victims.

items.title: SiYuan 2.1.0 before 3.8.9 contains a flaw where the loginAuth CAPTCHA challenge lives in a signed client-side cookie, a…
items.description: SiYuan 2.1.0 before 3.8.9 contains a flaw where the loginAuth CAPTCHA challenge lives in a signed client-side cookie, allowing reuse of a solved challenge. Attackers can replay the original signed siyuan cookie with distinct wrong access codes to brute-force the code and gain an administrator session.

items.title: SiYuan from 3.6.0 before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated publish vis…
items.description: SiYuan from 3.6.0 before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated publish visitors to bypass per-document passwords via regex search in getDoc. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/filetree/getDoc with queryMethod 3 and a broad regex to read protected body text returned in the unfiltered keywords field.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated base Viewers to obta…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated base Viewers to obtain TLS client private keys by reading a base's data source. The source read handler masked only the connection password, letting attackers retrieve the decrypted private key, client certificate and CA to connect directly to the external database, bypassing NocoDB permissions.

items.title: NocoDB from 0.300.0 before 2026.04.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to cras…
items.description: NocoDB from 0.300.0 before 2026.04.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to crash the server by triggering an unhandled promise rejection in MetaService metadata logging. Attackers can send a request leaving a lookup condition undefined, causing knex binding errors in the unawaited logHelper call that terminate the server process.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an IP address spoofing vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge th…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an IP address spoofing vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge their recorded source IP by supplying X-Forwarded-For headers, because Express trust proxy is enabled unconditionally. Attackers can write arbitrary source addresses into audit and request logs to mislead investigations and evade the per-address public API rate limiter.

items.title: NocoDB before 2026.09.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the aggregated meta info route of utils.cont…
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the aggregated meta info route of utils.controller.ts that exposes instance-wide metadata to anonymous callers. Unauthenticated attackers can request the endpoint to enumerate bases, user counts, shared and password-protected view counts, webhook counts, and live per-base row counts, while repeated requests amplify database query load.

items.title: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Uploa…
items.description: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2 via the cbforms_check_form_submissions function. This is due to missing server-side file extension validation in cbforms_check_form_submissions(), where the allowed-type check defaults to the uploaded file's own extension when no field restriction is configured, trivially allowing any extension including .php. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. The submission nonce printed inline on every public page containing a Chatterbug form is freely obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and therefore does not constitute an effective access control barrier.

items.title: SiYuan before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Reader users to retrieve…
items.description: SiYuan before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Reader users to retrieve credential-named widget files by bypassing the sensitive-path guard in getFile. Attackers can request paths like /data/widgets/<package>/credentials.json for publish-referenced widgets to obtain API keys, tokens, or other stored secrets.

items.title: The Passster – Password Protect Pages and Content plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via…
items.description: The Passster – Password Protect Pages and Content plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (metakeyinput=passster_id | passster_headline)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.21 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor can break out of the shortcode attribute context by embedding a ] character in the passster_id or passster_headline meta value to prematurely close the opening shortcode tag, then append a [/passster] closing tag so that the trailing HTML payload is emitted verbatim by do_shortcode() — bypassing the per-attribute escaping present inside render_shortcode() — and the script will also execute in an editor's or administrator's browser when they preview the Contributor's pending post, since filter_the_content() has no edit-permission capability gate.

items.title: The Recipe Card Blocks Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'steps[].text' pa…
items.description: The Recipe Card Blocks Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'steps[].text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.7.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Because wp_kses_post() preserves block-delimiter HTML comments verbatim on save, a Contributor can embed event-handler payloads inside the block's steps[].text attribute in a draft or pending post without the unfiltered_html capability, and the payload executes for any visitor — including privileged editors and administrators who preview or publish the post — as well as through the public print endpoint.

items.title: The WPZOOM Addons for Elementor – Starter Templates & Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site S…
items.description: The WPZOOM Addons for Elementor – Starter Templates & Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'actions[save_builder][data][elements][...][settings][regions][i][link][url] / [pins][i][link][url]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

items.title: The SureDash – Community, Courses & Member Dashboard plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all…
items.description: The SureDash – Community, Courses & Member Dashboard plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.13.0 This is due to the `save_settings()` REST handler at `/suredash/v1/save-settings` being gated only by `admin_permission_callback()`, which authorizes any holder of the custom `manage_portal_dashboard` capability (Portal Manager role) without requiring `promote_users`, `edit_users`, or `manage_options`, combined with `sanitize_settings_data()` iterating all attacker-supplied keys with no allow-list, allowing arbitrary keys such as `default_role` to pass through `sanitize_text_field()` unchanged and be persisted into the `portal_settings` option via `update_option()` with no role-validity check. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Portal Manager-level access and above to poison the `default_role` setting to `administrator`, after which any subsequent new-user registration through the publicly accessible block-register endpoint reads the corrupted setting and passes it directly to `wp_insert_user()`, producing a full WordPress Administrator account under the attacker's control. The exploit requires two steps: a POST to the authenticated `save-settings` endpoint to overwrite `default_role`, followed by triggering a new registration through the unauthenticated block-register endpoint to receive the escalated account. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete administrator role.

items.title: The Drag and Drop File Upload for Elementor Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to…
items.description: The Drag and Drop File Upload for Elementor Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the remove_files function in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.2 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is reachable when the "yeepdf_not_save" privacy option is enabled, a commonly used production setting that triggers the remove_files() cleanup path.

items.title: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via…
items.description: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT (demonstrated); more generally, any attacker-controllable DB column the saved report selects' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.25.25 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have saved a SQL report that selects an attacker-controllable database column, such as wp_comments.comment_agent, which WordPress stores verbatim from unauthenticated visitors even when comments are pending moderation.

items.title: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'user_email' parameter in all version…
items.description: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'user_email' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires the admin-controlled 'currentusersubscribed' option to be enabled and at least one page rendering the Newsletters subscribe shortcode or widget to exist; a Subscriber-level attacker can self-serve the attack by updating their own profile email to a crafted payload and loading such a page.

items.title: The Easy Property Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_type' parameter in…
items.description: The Easy Property Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_type' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.28 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The sanitize_text_field() function is applied to the attribute value but does not escape single quotes, providing no mitigation against breaking out of the SQL IN('...') literal.

items.title: The Customer Reviews for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions u…
items.description: The Customer Reviews for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions up to, and including, 5.127.0 via the 'search' parameter of the cr_show_more_all_reviews and cr_show_more_reviews AJAX actions. This is due to the handlers being hooked on wp_ajax_nopriv_* without a capability check (and, in the product-page handler, with a nonce check that is behind a filter defaulting to false) while passing the visitor-supplied search string straight into get_comments() as the 'search' argument, which core expands into LIKE conditions over comment_author, comment_author_email, comment_author_url, comment_author_IP and comment_content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract review author email addresses and IP addresses — fields WordPress and WooCommerce never expose to the public — one character at a time by observing whether the returned result set matches a probed substring.

items.title: The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in a…
items.description: The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.9 via the 'form (specifically the attacker-controlled ticket_label field inside the url-encoded form string)' parameter parameter. This is due to missing server-side authentication and the absence of a class allowlist on deserialization, with the only guard being a nonce publicly emitted on any page carrying the [wsdesk_support] shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server. A successful exploit requires a single anonymous GET to any public page carrying the [wsdesk_support] shortcode to harvest the publicly emitted wsdesk_nonce value, after which a single unauthenticated POST completes the attack.

items.title: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file…
items.description: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the handle_job function in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.5 This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). The 'NextGEN Manage gallery' capability required to reach the vulnerable endpoint is granted to Administrators by default but can be delegated to lower-privileged roles via the plugin's Roles screen.

items.title: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_category…
items.description: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_category' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is persisted in post meta as campaign_data, bypassing wp_kses sanitization, and executes in the browser session of any user with edit_posts — including Administrators — who opens the WPeMatico campaigns list screen.

items.title: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[additional_preview…
items.description: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[additional_previews][]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.6.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wpdm_sanitize_array() function strips HTML tags via wp_kses but leaves bare single quotes intact and calls stripslashes_deep() which defeats WordPress magic quotes protection, allowing a single-quote-based attribute breakout payload to be stored verbatim and later rendered without escaping.

items.title: The PowerPress Podcasting plugin by Blubrry plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '…
items.description: The PowerPress Podcasting plugin by Blubrry plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'width' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the site's configured video player is set to html5video, or when the media URL uses a .webm or .ogv extension, as these conditions are required to route the shortcode attributes through the vulnerable powerpressplayer_build_html5video() builder. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an editor — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

items.title: The CF7 Apps – Honeypot, Database, Redirection, Webhook, and Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerab…
items.description: The CF7 Apps – Honeypot, Database, Redirection, Webhook, and Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wpcf7-form (CF7 form body; the [honeypot ...] tag value)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.8.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only a meaningful privilege escalation on multisite installations or those with DISALLOW_UNFILTERED_HTML enabled, as Editor-level users on default single-site installs already possess the unfiltered_html capability.

items.title: The Widget Options – Advanced Conditional Visibility for Gutenberg Blocks & Classic Widgets plugin for WordPress is vul…
items.description: The Widget Options – Advanced Conditional Visibility for Gutenberg Blocks & Classic Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.6.1 via the `post_content` parameter. This is due to asymmetric parsing between the save-time strip filter (`widgetopts_strip_logic_from_blocks()`) and the render-time parser (`blockopts_filter_before_display()`): embedding an inner `<!--start_widgetopts` literal inside a JSON key causes the write-side `json_decode` to see a non-`class` key and skip stripping — persisting the payload verbatim to the database — while the render-side `str_replace` reconstitutes the key to `class`, feeding the attacker-controlled `logic` value directly into `@eval`. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to inject PHP expressions that execute on every front-end page view, enabling boolean-oracle exfiltration of WordPress site configuration data — including admin email address, default role, and arbitrary `get_option`, `get_user_meta`, and `get_post_meta` values — via the plugin's allowlisted-function sandbox, which escalates to unrestricted code execution if any installed plugin extends the `widgetopts_allowed_php_functions` filter. Contributors can also exploit this vulnerability when their submitted post is later published by an administrator; notably, the injected payload executes for all site visitors, including unauthenticated users, because a trust-flag mechanism introduced in version 4.2.6 causes `widgetopts_safe_eval_trusted()` to bypass its non-admin short-circuit at every legacy render callsite. Exploitation by attackers with contributor-level access and above requires that an administrator (or editor) later publishes the contributor's submission. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

items.title: The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Quiz Maker & Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injectio…
items.description: The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Quiz Maker & Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'qpages' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.2.9 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The injected payload survives storage and a published-status check in display_shortcode() because a non-numeric ID causes the isPublished lookup to return an empty string, after which the payload is imploded directly into a WHERE question_id IN() clause via plain string interpolation with no wpdb->prepare() or esc_sql() call.

items.title: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is…
items.description: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Directory Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 4.19.0. This is due to insufficient path validation in the `cleanStagingDirectory` function, where the `deleteDir` parameter is only stripped of whitespace and double slashes by `sanitizePath()` without removing `..` traversal sequences or enforcing containment within the staging directory, leaving the sole pre-deletion guard as a simple string equality check against the WordPress home path. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to recursively delete arbitrary directories on the server — including `wp-content`, `wp-admin`, or directories outside the WordPress installation on shared hosting — resulting in denial of service or permanent data loss. An attacker must sequence a clone start, cancellation, and restart to drive the `delete_job` cache into the `directory` step before re-cancelling with a manipulated `deleteDir` value supplied via the `wp_ajax_wpstg_cancel_clone` endpoint.

items.title: Edito CMS deserializes JSON data without further validation.
items.description:
Edito CMS deserializes JSON data without further validation. A user (even an administrator) cannot exploit this vulnerability through the application's normal functionality. An attacker who could modify cache entries or inject them could execute code on the server.




This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

items.title: Edito CMS restricts the ability to upload files via the UI to specific file types.
items.description:
Edito CMS restricts the ability to upload files via the UI to specific file types. However, an avatar upload functionality allows an attacker to upload files of any type and extension without restriction.
This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

items.title: Edito CMS sends JWT token via GET requests.
items.description:
Edito CMS sends JWT token via GET requests. This allows a local attacker with access to browser history to obtain valid JWT token and perform action on behalf of the victim. The token is valid for only short period of time; after that time, it expires and can no longer be used.



The vendor assessed the likelihood of exploitation as very low and determined that a fix is not necessary.
